answer_1.quote: We introduce a novel task, self-disclosure abstraction, which rephrases disclosures with less specific details while preserving the content utility (see Figure). This task operates at the span level and is evaluated against paraphrasing and sentence‑level abstraction.

answer_2.quote: We adopt matching BLEU and ROUGE metrics proposed by ... to encourage diversity in generated abstractions. These matching metrics use the Hungarian algorithm to calculate the highest matching scores among one‑to‑one pairings.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct a human evaluation on 60 sampled self-disclosure test instances. We first use Rank & Rate to rate the abstractions ... each model is evaluated on privacy increase, utility preservation, diversity (1‑5 Likert scales) and a binary assessment of coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each abstraction on Likert scales for privacy increase, utility preservation, diversity, and indicated whether the abstraction was coherent within the original sentence.
